## Summary

Describe the focused change and its motivation.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and offline smoke test pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, personal data, or machine-specific paths are included.
- [ ] New data have documented provenance, redistribution rights, schemas, and checksums.
- [ ] Empirical claims remain consistent with machine-readable evidence.
- [ ] Synthetic outputs are clearly labeled and are not presented as empirical model results.
